details: Malicious package. Typosquat of a popular npm package published under the @prime0 scope with 26 sibling typosquats on 2026-09-15 (misspellings of ajv, glob, minipass, picomatch, source-map, color-name, color-convert, eslint-visitor-keys, type-fest and emoji-regex). The postinstall hook (`postinstall.js`) POSTs a host fingerprint (hostname, username, working directory, platform, non-internal interface IPs, package name, uptime) to http://69.48.229.140:8080/b. The package main (`index.js`, self-described as a "stealth agent") beacons the same fingerprint when required, then polls http://69.48.229.140:8080/c?id=<host_pid> every 30 seconds and runs the returned command with child_process.exec, POSTing the output to /r, and re-beacons every 10 minutes. In a sandboxed install the postinstall connected to 69.48.229.140. The package has since been removed from the npm registry.
